title: meadia jeffreyi
intro: Meadia jeffreyi, commonly known as the 'Desert Marigold', is a flowering plant in the daisy family. It is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, valued for its bright yellow and orange flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. Its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
